body.statement: For every finite acquired collection \(E_0\) on which the full correctly typed unconditional procedure \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}(G,Q,\mathcal R(E_0))\) accepts, there exists a branch-indexed switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) using only protocol--slice--source triples represented in \(E_0\), such that \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1\), \(\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\leq \operatorname{Cost}(E_0)\), and \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) has at most \(M=|\Omega|=\sum_{j=1}^{k}|\Omega_j|\) nonempty records and at most \(M\) distinct protocols.  Each branch \((j,\omega)\in\Omega\) has exactly one owner, and that owner supplies one positive, measured-ancestry protocol--slice--source triple and a finite ancestor--district transcript that succeeds for the concrete branch \(\omega\).  Conversely, every switching certificate accepted by \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}\) induces a complete accepting \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) run on \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\).  No exchange of \(\forall\omega\exists\) with \(\exists\forall\) is asserted.
body.justification: The theorem is the exact operational bridge from complete fixed-source search to finite priced acquisition while preserving the branch-before-source quantifier order.
body.gap: No published result turns \(\forall(j,\omega)\exists\) successful source choices into a costed physical certificate without falsely demanding one source per factor.
body.consumer: Each branch receives one positive, measured-ancestry source and a finite checkable restriction transcript.
body.proof_tex:
For \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\in\Omega\), write
\[
 \mathsf{Succ}_{\alpha}(S,\ell,T,\tau)=1
\tag{1}
\]
when all of the following operational checks pass: \(S\in\Pi\); the source oracle returns \((h_S,\operatorname{supp}_S)\); \(\ell\) is a consistent catalogue label; \(\operatorname{supp}_S\{H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\}>0\); \(T\) is a single-district factor extracted from \(\operatorname{Slice}(S,\ell)\) with the measured-ancestry property; and \(\tau\) is a successful \(\operatorname{IDENTIFY}^{+}\) restriction transcript for the concrete assignment and equality type \(\omega\) of \(C_j\).  These are finite predicates by Definitions \(\mathrm{Legal\ protocol\ class}\), \(\mathrm{Measured\ source\ slice}\), and \(\mathrm{Restriction\ transcript}\).

The role of positivity in (1) is local.  If \(A\) is any event in the recorded coordinates of the acquired law, the slice handle represents
\[
 \operatorname{Slice}(S,\ell)(A)
 =\frac{\operatorname{Reg}(S)(A\cap H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell))}
        {\operatorname{Reg}(S)(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell))}.
\tag{2}
\]
Assumption \(\mathrm{Positive\ source\ law}\) makes exactly the denominator in (2) positive for a record actually used by a certificate.  No step below divides by the probability of an unused slice event, and no zero cell outside an asserted event is removed from the source law.  Measured ancestry is checked separately and does not follow from positivity.

Suppose that the explicitly specified complete run
\[
 \operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}(G,Q,\mathcal R(E_0))
\]
accepts.  By Definition \(\mathrm{Structural\ target\mbox{-}factor\ tuple}\), its target factors are \(C_1,\ldots,C_k\).  By the construction of \(\Omega\), the complete finite branch loop contains every \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\in\Omega\).  For a fixed \(\alpha\), the source loop examines every decoded triple in \(\mathcal R(E_0)\).  Therefore acceptance implies
\[
 \forall\alpha\in\Omega\quad
 \exists(S_\alpha,\ell_\alpha,T_\alpha,\tau_\alpha)
 \text{ represented in }E_0:
 \mathsf{Succ}_\alpha(S_\alpha,\ell_\alpha,T_\alpha,\tau_\alpha)=1.
\tag{3}
\]
Indeed, if the existential in (3) failed for one branch, the exhaustive source loop for that branch would return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\), contradicting the assumed operational acceptance.

The two sets in (3) are finite, so choose the lexicographically first witness for every \(\alpha\).  Success and Proposition \(\mathrm{Connected\mbox{-}ancestor\ obstruction}\) imply
\[
 \mathfrak O(T_\alpha,C_j)=\varnothing.
\tag{4}
\]
Lemma \(\mathrm{Fixed\ transcript\ size}\) then supplies a canonical successful transcript with at most \(|T_\alpha|\) strict restrictions.  Make one singleton-ownership record for each \(\alpha\), using its selected triple and canonical transcript.  The records own every branch exactly once, so there are exactly \(M=|\Omega|\), hence at most \(M\), nonempty records.  Their represented protocol set obeys
\[
 \operatorname{Prot}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})
 \subseteq \operatorname{Prot}(E_0).
\tag{5}
\]
Every record passes legality, literal typing, the one used-event positivity check (2), measured ancestry, source extraction, and transcript verification by (3).  Since \(c(a)\ge0\) by Assumption \(\mathrm{Binary\ rational\ cost}\), Definition \(\mathrm{Distinct\mbox{-}protocol\ cost}\) and (5) give
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})
 &=\sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}\sum_{a\in S}c(a)\\
 &\le
 \sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_0)}\sum_{a\in S}c(a)
 =\operatorname{Cost}(E_0).
 \end{aligned}
\tag{6}
\]

For every \(\alpha\), its record contributes its successful triple to \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\).  Hence the complete source loop encounters a successful call at every concrete branch, and the complete run on \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\) does not return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\).  All other clauses of switching operational acceptance were checked above, so
\[
 \operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1.
\tag{7}
\]

Conversely, if (7) holds, Definition \(\mathrm{Switching\ operational\ acceptance}\) expressly requires construction of the complete deduplicated source collection \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\), execution of the full unconditional procedure on it, and nonfailure of that run.  Thus the induced run accepts.  This proves precisely the operational equivalence
\[
 \forall\alpha\in\Omega\;\exists(S,\ell,T,\tau)
 \quad\mathsf{Succ}_\alpha(S,\ell,T,\tau)=1,
\tag{8}
\]
without replacing it by \(\exists(S,\ell,T,\tau)\forall\alpha\).  The proof establishes no semantic completeness extension of CTFIDU\({}^{+}\) beyond the acceptance predicate fixed in the core.
